risk_note: B1-34t (admin, RV2; BR-ID-43; FU-ADMIN-SUPER-TOTP-SELF-RESET; D10-2945 / D10-2947 / D10-2999 / D10-3058 → D10-3061). New operations command apps/api/scripts/admin-totp-reset.ts and use case admin/application/operator-totp-reset.ts reset the authenticator of the sole super admin: one transaction locks the target and the app's super rows, refuses when another usable super exists (same app, is_super, active, bound), clears the three totp columns by row_version, writes a system audit row (system_actor system:ops_command, action admin_totp_reset, target admins:<id>) and voids the account's credentials (admin-revocations voidBefore, before commit, as adminResetAdminTotp). Already unbound → nothing written, own exit code; state changed between preview and confirm → nothing written; confirmation text decoded across chunks and without swallowing a BOM. Contract: audit_system_actor gains system:ops_command (enums/admin.yaml, openapi, oasdiff-accepted, contracts-ts), audit-log-view Chinese name. HTTP resetTotp and its controller unchanged.

reviews.note: Codex money review via tools/agent/codex-run.sh (implementation by Opus, approvals 27). money r1 fail: S1 ① void before commit (kept, same as adminResetAdminTotp, D10-2999; FU-ADMIN-CREDENTIAL-VERSION-PG), S1 ② retry after a delivered-but-unreported reset (fixed in impl r2), S1 ③ no SMS login after reset (kept, matches contract; FU-B134T-SMS-LOGIN-AFTER-RESET), S2 UTF-8 across chunks (fixed). couli-runs/B1-34t/review-money-r1.json money r2 fail: S1 state changed during confirmation (fixed in impl r3 by comparing the previewed state), S2 BOM (fixed). couli-runs/B1-34t/review-money-r2.json money r3 fail: S0 void instant in ms vs whole-second iat (strict <). Checked against main: after the reset the account is unbound and old sessions are refused; rebinding voids again at the binding login's whole second (admin-login.ts:408-417, B1-34n), pinned by frozen [AC-B1-34n#1][#2]. D10-3058 small task withdrawn by D10-3061. couli-runs/B1-34t/review-money-r3.json money r4 (one-time approvals entry 197, D10-3061; scope: r3 S0 under main's existing defences and the rebase onto #752) pass; validator moved 0; one reviewer-placed out-of-scope S1 (main admins.controller.ts still asks TOTP step-up for resetting another admin) belongs to B1-18l (D10-3077). couli-runs/B1-34t/review-money-r4.json No finding was moved to out_of_scope in any round (D10-2954).
